moves.text: Start the Bears D/ST (vs NO, 1:00 PM) over the Vikings D/ST (vs SF in Mexico City, Sun 8:20 PM)
moves.why: The Bears project 6.01 at home against a Saints offense that scored 17 against Carolina last week. The Vikings project 4.47, the lowest in the lineup, against Purdy, who just threw for 389 yards and 3 TDs at Dallas (ESPN). Starting the Vikings also bets against your own QB in the same game. Both D/STs are healthy. Make the swap before the Bears lock at 1 PM Sunday.

moves.text: The Bijan + Kittle offer is still worth it, even though Bijan is on bye this week
moves.why: ESPN lists ATL on bye in Week 11, so Bijan scores 0 this week if the offer is accepted before it expires (~Wed Nov 19, 4:55 PM). That costs little this week: Gibbs, Coleman and Gordon fill RB/FLEX, Kittle (healthy, 6-74 Sun) replaces Kincaid at TE, and Tyson (11.74, NO @ CHI 1:00 PM) replaces Wilson (13.93), a drop of about 2 points against an opponent projected at 67.6. From Week 12 on you get an RB1 and a TE1. Note that Purdy, Kittle and Evans would all play SF's Sunday night game.

moves.text: If the trade goes through, use the open roster spot on a WR: check waivers for one playing Sunday
moves.why: The deal sends three players and brings back two, which frees one roster spot. After Wilson leaves, the WRs are Moore, Tyson and Evans (Q, Achilles; ESPN return date Nov 22; Shanahan 'hoping to' have him practice this week). Even if Evans plays, his Sunday 8:20 PM kickoff means you'd want a healthy fallback. That kickoff also leaves time to swap him in or out after SF's inactives.

moves.text: Keep Jonah Coleman starting at RB2
moves.why: 19.39 vs LV at home, well above Jaylen Warren's 15.68 at PHI; Coleman is in the lineup after his Week 10 bye.

moves.text: Pending offer: Bijan Robinson + George Kittle for Warren + Wilson + Kincaid
moves.why: Proposed by Brian Nov 17, 4:55 PM, expires ~Nov 19. Upgrades RB2 and TE, but leaves only Tyson (11.74) behind Moore at WR if Wilson goes.

moves.text: Watch Mike Evans (Q) practice reports Wed-Fri
moves.why: Shanahan hopes Evans practices this week after missing three games with Achilles tendinitis; if cleared (12.05 vs MIN) he is a bench/flex option, but both starting WRs project higher.
